checkout_materialization: Each standalone git init fetches only the pinned commit from the same local Cal.com object cache. Working-tree and untracked files are not copied. OS filesystem caches are not reset.
provider_cache: Fresh sessions and disabled cache warming do not guarantee a cold provider prefix cache; cache-read token usage is reported.
effective_prompt: Identical recorded instructions; Pi additionally appends each run's unique checkout path as cwd.

timings.runner_elapsed_seconds: Runner wall time including authentication, checkout preparation, model/tool loop and internal verification; excludes the separate verification process.
timings.process_wall_seconds: Monotonic CLI launch-to-exit wall time, including process startup and shutdown.
timings.preparation_seconds: Monotonic time from CLI launch to its running event.
timings.generation_through_exit_seconds: CLI wall time minus preparation; includes model/tool loop plus internal verification and shutdown. Not model-only latency.
timings.batch_wall_seconds: All three sequential CLI processes and their separate verification passes; excludes harness preflight and viewer validation.

usage.source: Sum of provider usage returned by Pi, once per completed assistant response.
usage.total_tokens: input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite; reasoning, when present, is a subset of output.
usage.cost: Pi catalog estimate only; cost_usd remains null. This does not measure billed charges or ChatGPT plan allowance consumption.

publication.frozen_graphs: Copied byte-for-byte; original SHA-256 values retained.
publication.run_records: run_directory changed to .; original_run_id added. All measured fields retained. Original raw run-record hash recorded in statistics.json.
publication.test_logs: Local repo and Node executable paths replaced by <repo> and <node>. Initial incorrect-cwd attempt retained separately.
publication.transcripts: Exact source-tool JSONL, losslessly gzipped. Full model event streams, source checkouts and credentials are not published.
